quests.instruction: Which item do we wear before we go outside to build a snowman or make snow angels?
quests.question: Snowsuit
quests.hint: It is thick and puffy.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Snowsuit covers your whole body in one warm piece for playing in deep snow!
quests.funFact: Snowsuits keep you warm even while you build snowmen for hours.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear that clips onto the front and back of our trousers?
quests.question: Suspenders
quests.hint: They clip onto the front and back of your pants.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Suspenders clip over your shoulders to hold your pants up without a belt!
quests.funFact: Suspenders clip onto your pants at both the front and the back.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear like a superhero wears while flying through the sky?
quests.question: Cape
quests.hint: Superheroes often wear these.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Cape ties at your neck and flows behind you for a bold, heroic look!
quests.funFact: Superheroes in stories almost always wear a bold, flowing cape.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear that is hard on the outside to protect us from a bump?
quests.question: Helmet
quests.hint: It is hard on the outside.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Helmet has a hard shell that protects your head during sports and biking!
quests.funFact: Helmets buckle snugly under your chin so they stay in place.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear that helps us float safely on top of the water?
quests.question: Life Jacket
quests.hint: It buckles around your chest.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Life Jacket helps you float safely, worn for water safety near deep water!
quests.funFact: Wearing a life jacket on a boat keeps everyone safer near deep water.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear instead of a hoodie, when we want warmth without a hood?
quests.question: Sweatshirt
quests.hint: It pulls over your head.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Sweatshirt is thick and warm like a hoodie, but has no hood at all!
quests.funFact: Sweatshirts were first made for athletes to wear before and after playing.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that zips or buttons up the front, and also when we go outside on a cool morning?
quests.question: Jacket
quests.hint: You put this on over your shirt!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Jacket keeps chilly wind off your body so you stay warm!
quests.funFact: Jackets keep the cold wind out so we stay cozy!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that sits right on top of our hair, and also to keep the warm sun out of our eyes?
quests.question: Hat
quests.hint: It sits right on top of your head!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Hat sits on top of your head to keep it warm or shady!
quests.funFact: Hats block the hot sun from our eyes!

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear around our collar for a fancy, formal outfit?
quests.question: Tie
quests.hint: Think about this: It is knotted around your collar.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Tie is knotted at the collar to make an outfit look fancy and formal!
quests.funFact: Ties come in every color, pattern, and even shape you can imagine.

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear on our legs, stretchy and snug from waist to ankle?
quests.question: Leggings
quests.hint: Think about this: They are thinner and more flexible than jeans.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Leggings are soft and stretchy, moving easily with your legs when you play!
quests.funFact: Leggings can be worn alone or underneath a skirt or dress.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that flows and twirls when we spin around, and also instead of a shirt and skirt worn separately?
quests.question: Dress
quests.hint: It is one piece that covers your whole body!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Dress is one piece of clothing that covers your whole body at once!
quests.funFact: A dress is one single piece of clothing, not two separate parts!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that is taller and sturdier than regular shoes, and also when we splash through puddles or trudge through snow?
quests.question: Boots
quests.hint: They cover more of your leg than regular shoes!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Boots reach up past your ankle to keep your feet safe and dry!
quests.funFact: Boots reach higher up your leg than regular shoes do!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear before we tie the laces or fasten the straps, and also to protect our feet from sharp rocks and hot ground?
quests.question: Shoes
quests.hint: They go on your feet before you go outside!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Shoes protect your feet when you walk, run, and play outside!
quests.funFact: Shoes protect our feet from sharp rocks and hot ground!

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear to go swimming in a pool or at the beach?
quests.question: Swimsuit
quests.hint: Think about this: It is made to get wet and dry fast.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Swimsuit is made to get wet and dry quickly for swimming!
quests.funFact: The very first swimsuits were made of wool, which got very heavy when wet.

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear around our waist to hold our pants up?
quests.question: Belt
quests.hint: Think about this: It threads through little loops on your pants.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Belt goes around your waist to keep your pants from slipping down!
quests.funFact: Belts can be made of leather, cloth, or even stretchy elastic.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear right after our warm bath in the evening, and also instead of our regular clothes once bedtime arrives?
quests.question: Pajamas
quests.hint: You wear these to bed!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Pajamas are soft and comfy, made for wearing all night while you sleep!
quests.funFact: Pajamas are made extra soft and loose so you can sleep comfortably!

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear over our eyes on a bright, sunny day?
quests.question: Sunglasses
quests.hint: Think about this: They have two dark lenses.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Sunglasses shade your eyes so bright sunlight does not hurt them!
quests.funFact: Good sunglasses also help block harmful rays from the sun.

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear over our clothes when the rain starts to fall?
quests.question: Raincoat
quests.hint: Think about this: It often has a hood.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Raincoat keeps rain from soaking your clothes on a wet, drizzly day!
quests.funFact: Many raincoats have a hood attached to keep your hair dry too.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that drapes loosely down over our shoulders and arms, and also shaped like a simple square with a hole for our head?
quests.question: Poncho
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It has a hole for your head, and that's it!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Poncho is a simple piece with a head-hole that drapes over your shoulders!
quests.funFact: A poncho is just one simple piece with a hole cut for your head!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear instead of soft cotton pants, for extra-tough play, and also made from a sturdy blue fabric called denim?
quests.question: Jeans
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They are usually a deep blue color!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Jeans are made from tough denim, strong enough for climbing and rough play!
quests.funFact: Jeans are made from a strong, sturdy fabric called denim!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that lets us pretend to be someone completely different for a day, and also for a fun dress-up party or a school play?
quests.question: Costume
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You wear this to pretend to be someone else!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Costume lets you dress up and pretend to be someone or something fun!
quests.funFact: A costume can turn you into a superhero, a dragon, or anything you imagine!

quests.instruction: What do we wear that a magician or a waiter often wears at work?
quests.question: Bow Tie
quests.hint: Hint: Magicians sometimes wear these.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Bow Tie is tied into a small bow shape at the collar for a fancy look!
quests.funFact: Magicians and waiters often wear a smart bow tie at work.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear instead of a cap, when we want our whole head warm, and also made of soft, stretchy, knitted material?
quests.question: Beanie
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It has no brim at all!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Beanie is a snug knitted hat with no brim, keeping your whole head warm!
quests.funFact: A beanie has no brim, so it hugs your whole head snugly!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that keeps our socks bone dry, no matter how deep the puddle, and also when we jump and splash in puddles after a storm?
quests.question: Rain Boots
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They are made of waterproof rubber!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Rain Boots are made of waterproof rubber, keeping your feet dry in puddles!
quests.funFact: Rain boots are made of rubber, so water cannot soak through them!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear on a breezy day when we do not want to feel chilly, and also when it is not cold enough for a thick winter coat?
quests.question: Windbreaker
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is thin, but it still blocks the wind!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Windbreaker is thin and light, yet still blocks a gusty breeze!
quests.funFact: A windbreaker is thin, but it still keeps gusty wind off your skin!

quests.instruction: What do we wear that looks a little like headphones, but for warmth?
quests.question: Earmuffs
quests.hint: Hint: A padded band connects the two sides.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Earmuffs cover just your ears with a padded band, keeping them warm!
quests.funFact: Some earmuffs fold flat so they are easy to carry in a bag.

quests.instruction: What do we wear under a jacket, so we still feel cool once it's off?
quests.question: Tank Top
quests.hint: Hint: You might wear this under a jacket in summer.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Tank Top has no sleeves at all, keeping your arms cool on hot days!
quests.funFact: Athletes often wear tank tops so their arms can move freely.

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear over a shirt, but with no sleeves at all?
quests.question: Vest
quests.hint: Think about this: It covers your chest and back, but your arms are free.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Vest covers your chest with no sleeves, so your arms stay free!
quests.funFact: Some vests are worn for fancy outfits, and some for safety at work.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear in the kitchen, right before we start cooking dinner, and also over our clothes while we bake cookies or paint a picture?
quests.question: Apron
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You wear this over your clothes while cooking or painting!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Apron ties over your clothes to protect them from spills and splashes!
quests.funFact: An apron catches spills and splatters before they reach your clothes!

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear on our feet when we relax at home?
quests.question: Slippers
quests.hint: Think about this: You slide these on easily, with no laces.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Slippers are soft and easy to slide on, perfect for relaxing at home!
quests.funFact: You can slide slippers on and off in just a second, with no laces.
